title: How is Nelson Mandela connected to Napoleon?
description:
Five photos and two paintings link Nelson Mandela to Napoleon.

Nelson Mandela → George W. Bush → Gerald Ford → Richard Nixon → Edward VIII → Queen Victoria → Napoleon III → Napoleon

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

Photo credits:
Photo 1, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_George_W._Bush_and_Former_President_Nelson_Mandela_of_South_Africa_Meet_in_the_Oval_Office.jpg
Photo 2 by George W. Bush Presidential Library, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_George_W._Bush,_Former_President_Gerald_Ford_and_Mrs._Betty_Ford_Greet_the_Media_in_Rancho_Mirage,_California_(P042306ED-1123).jpg
Photo 3, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mr._and_Mrs._Ford_and_Nixon_13_Oct_1973.jpg
Photo 4, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nixon_and_the_Windsors.jpg
Photo 5 by Percy Lewis Pocock, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Edward_VIII_Christening.webp
Photo 6 by Edward Matthew Ward, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Edward_Matthew_Ward_(1816-79)_-_Queen_Victoria_at_the_Tomb_of_Napoleon,_24_August_1855_-_RCIN_402019_-_Royal_Collection.jpg
